dogecoin.text:
@SahilC0 @jpmorgan @river He was 100% serious. I spoke to him for another 15 minutes and he was convinced Dogecoin would replace Bitcoin as a store of value. 

Crazy how people in high up positions can be so ill-informed.

Last weekend I went to a BBQ and spoke with a senior member of @jpmorgan:

Me: "I work for @river a #Bitcoin only brokerage."

JPM Employee: "Bitcoin is a dinosaur, Ethereum 2.0 and Dogecoin are the future. I sold all of my Bitcoin at $19k."

Me: "Have fun staying poor..."
